diagrams.title: 8085 microprocessor architecture (block model)
diagrams.cap: 8085: 8-bit data, 16-bit address (64 KB), 5 hardware interrupts with TRAP highest and non-maskable. 8086 widens this to 16-bit data and a 20-bit address (1 MB).

keys.title: Key formula explained — 8086 physical address
fields: The 16-bit segment is shifted left by one hex digit (× 16) and added to the 16-bit offset to form a 20-bit address.

Segment = CS, DS, SS or ES
offset = IP, SI, DI, BX, SP …
Q. DS = 4000H, offset 0005H? → 40005H Q. Max memory of 8086? → 1 MB
notes: ⚠ Trap: Shift the SEGMENT left (×16), not the offset.
